optionReasons.saa-avc-221:option:0: One single HSM is a single point of failure — weekly backup does not give the high availability of operations.
optionReasons.saa-avc-221:option:2: It is the closest because two HSMs already give redundancy — but in MESMA AZ: a failure of AZ drops both together; high production availability requires cluster with HSMs at least DUAS AZs, with automatic key synchronization and balancing.

finalJustifications: Because the cluster CloudHSM with HSMs in at least two AZs synchronizes and balances the keys automatically: operations continue if an AZ falls, with single-tenant keys under company control.

optionReasons.saa-avc-223:option:0: Storage snapshot + non-converting restore Oracle→PostgreSQL (HETEROGENE migration) — incompatible.
optionReasons.saa-avc-223:option:2: It's the closest because exporting a dump and importing into Aurora migrates the data in fact — but it's the ONLY load: the bank receives write CONTINUA, and the dump would be outdated in the cutover (downtime of hours, not minutes); convert the schema (SCT) and replicate continuously (DMS full load + CDC) till it turns is the migration almost without downtime.
optionReasons.saa-avc-223:option:3: DataSync copy ARQUIVOS — does not convert or replicate transactions from an Oracle bank to the Aurora PostgreSQL.

finalJustifications: Because SCT converts Oracle→PostgreSQL schema and the DMS Make full load + CDC replicating the continuous writings until the cutover — the turn takes place with downtime of a few minutes.
